name: Add Sauce Labs Backpack to cart and reach checkout overview
description: Logs in, adds the 'Sauce Labs Backpack' item to the cart, fills the checkout information form, and reaches the order review (checkout overview) page — stopping short of placing the order, which is a separate, risk-gated action. Returns the displayed order totals.

inputs.name: username
inputs.description: Login username for the target account.

inputs.name: password
inputs.description: Login password for the target account.

inputs.name: postalCode
inputs.description: Checkout billing postal/zip code. An empty or invalid value surfaces a 'validation_error' business outcome rather than a crash.

outputs.name: itemTotalText
outputs.description: The 'Item total' line as displayed on the checkout overview page.

outputs.name: taxText
outputs.description: The 'Tax' line as displayed on the checkout overview page.

outputs.name: totalText
outputs.description: The 'Total' line as displayed on the checkout overview page.

steps.locatorReasoning: Accessible name 'Username' comes from the field's placeholder and is stable; role+name preferred, testId as a strong fallback.
Same rationale as username: stable placeholder-derived accessible name.
Accessible name 'Login' is derived from the submit input's `value` attribute (not text content, since <input> elements are self-closing) — stable across reloads.

expected.description: Login rejected because the account has been locked out by the site admin.

steps.locatorReasoning: IMPORTANT: every product tile exposes an 'Add to cart' button with the identical role and accessible name — role+name alone resolves to 7 elements on this page, confirmed directly against the live app. testId is unique per product and is therefore preferred over the usual role-first default.

Accessible name encodes the live cart count ('Cart, N items') and is therefore state-dependent — confirmed it reads 'Cart, empty' before any item is added. testId is stable regardless of cart contents and is preferred.
Unique, stable accessible name on the cart page.

No usable accessible name was observed for this control (neither a computed accessible name nor text content) — this app doesn't consistently expose one here, which is exactly the kind of gap the brief calls out for legacy/uncooperative surfaces. testId is the only reliable signal for this element; documented rather than silently worked around.
